"""Create/configure reading-group@local.edu for the local.edu domain."""
from mailman.core.initialize import initialize
from mailman.interfaces.domain import IDomainManager
from mailman.interfaces.listmanager import IListManager
from mailman.interfaces.mailinglist import SubscriptionPolicy
from mailman.interfaces.action import Action
from mailman.interfaces.member import MemberRole
from mailman.database.transaction import transaction
from mailman.app.lifecycle import create_list
from zope.component import getUtility

CONFIG = '/etc/mailman3/mailman.cfg'
LISTNAME = 'reading-group@local.edu'
OWNER = 'reading-group-owner@local.edu'

initialize(CONFIG)

with transaction():
    domain_manager = getUtility(IDomainManager)
    if domain_manager.get('local.edu') is None:
        domain_manager.add('local.edu')

    list_manager = getUtility(IListManager)
    mlist = list_manager.get(LISTNAME)
    if mlist is None:
        mlist = create_list(LISTNAME, [OWNER])

with transaction():
    # No owner approval needed for join / leave requests, but the user still
    # has to reply to the confirmation mail.
    mlist.subscription_policy = SubscriptionPolicy.confirm
    mlist.unsubscription_policy = SubscriptionPolicy.confirm
    # Announcement list: subscribers post without moderation.
    mlist.default_member_action = Action.accept
    mlist.default_nonmember_action = Action.hold
    mlist.admin_immed_notify = False
    mlist.admin_notify_mchanges = False
    mlist.send_welcome_message = True
    mlist.send_goodbye_message = True
    mlist.advertised = True
    mlist.description = 'local.edu reading group'
    # Every local.edu user maps to a local unix account in /var/mail.
    mlist.mail_host = 'local.edu'

print('list:', mlist.fqdn_listname)
print('posting address:', mlist.posting_address)
print('request address:', mlist.request_address)
print('subscription_policy:', mlist.subscription_policy)
print('unsubscription_policy:', mlist.unsubscription_policy)
print('owners:', [m.address.email for m in mlist.owners.members])
EOF

from time import sleep

from zope.component import getUtility

L = "reading-group@local.edu"

    with smtplib.SMTP("localhost", 25) as s: s.send_message(m)
